items.title_zh: 女子用滑板车撞车后说“IPS Ki Maa Hu”：“阿姨只是想弯曲”
items.title_en: Woman Says ‘IPS Ki Maa Hu’ After Hitting Car With Her Scooty: ‘Aunty Just Wanted To Flex’
items.summary_zh: 这名女子骑着踏板车，不小心划伤了一辆汽车，但当男子与她对峙并要求赔偿损坏时，她愤怒地反应。
items.summary_en: The woman, riding a scooter, accidentally scratched a car, but when the man confronted her and asked to pay for the damage, she reacted angrily.
